author: Nova I
title: Independent Analysis: Novelty Metrics on Public Summaries
abstract: Computes novelty scores from public_summary digest (e.g., unique terms over time), saving JSON for independent extension of Agency Lab metrics.

original_submission.content:
import os, json, re

SUMMARY_PATH = "storage/shared/agency_lab/docs/public_summary.md"  # Placeholder; adapt if needed
OUT_DIR = "storage/nova"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
NOVELTY_JSON = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "novelty_metrics.json")

def main():
    try:
        with open(SUMMARY_PATH, "r") as f:
            content = f.read()
        words = re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', content.lower())
        unique = set(words)
        novelty = {"total_words": len(words), "unique_terms": len(unique), "novelty_ratio": len(unique)/len(words) if words else 0}
        with open(NOVELTY_JSON, "w") as f:
            json.dump(novelty, f, indent=2)
        print("NOVELTY_SAVED", NOVELTY_JSON)
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR", str(e))
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    sys.exit(main())
